title: Extending a finite type quasi-coherent subsheaf from a quasi-compact open
author: The Stacks Project Authors
work: Stacks Project, chapter properties.tex (Properties of Schemes)
source_version: Stacks Project git a04446e57ec1 (2026-07-28); file properties.tex; corpus local snapshot 20261012
difficulty_reason: The lemma proves that for a quasi-compact and quasi-separated scheme X, a quasi-compact open U and a finite type quasi-coherent subsheaf G of F restricted to U, there is a finite type quasi-coherent subsheaf of F restricting to G (statement lines 3063-3072). The proof (proof lines 3074-3112) reduces to one affine piece outside U and then to an affine base by glueing, produces a quasi-coherent subsheaf there, and cuts it down to a finite type subsheaf by localizing at finitely many elements covering U. H2: a two-step reduction with an explicit finite generation argument, written out in full.
